  Owner of the project? Troubleshoot following things:

-
      [Retry](/retry/org.mapstruct/mapstruct-parent/1.7.0.Beta2)this version.
      Sometimes it's just a matter of time to pick up new versions.
- Is the mapstruct-parent-1.7.0.Beta2-javadoc.jar actually distributed to either maven or bintray?
- Does the mapstruct-parent-1.7.0.Beta2-javadoc.jar file contains an index.html in the extracted root folder? (you can rename .jar to .zip to extract the file)

    ](https://github.com/maxcellent/javadoc.io/issues)
  if you tried everything but still doesn't work.
